title: Creamy Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful fried rice dish with a creamy twist. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fried
ingredients.amount: 1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g. peas, carrots, corn)

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add a little more oil if necessary, then pour in the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return the vegetables to the other side of the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the frozen corn kernels and cook until they are thawed and heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
